description: Every price change for a game, newest first (Data plan). Use it for line movement and closing odds.

limit.description: Maximum number of price changes to return (default 100).

market.description: Only price changes for this market.

period.description: Only price changes for this period, e.g. 'ft' for the full game.

provider.description: Only this bookmaker, e.g. pinnacle (see list_providers)
